title: The Clock of Manchester's mill district
author: Petra Dunmore
blurb: Yara Vasquez, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
